name: The Footprint Pour
prompt: Follow a young sauropod across a keeper's clay paddock. Staff cast its last deep footprint in pale plaster while visitors compare a finished cast with their own shoes on a raised walkway.

name: Breakfast at Frill Height
prompt: Put a low feeding hedge beside a triceratops enclosure. Gardeners clip branches on one side while the animals push their frills through generous feeding arches on the other.

name: The Egg Hospital
prompt: Arrange warm sand nests around an open-sided hatchery. A keeper weighs a speckled egg, another turns one by hand, and a small hatchling follows damp tracks toward its waiting parent.

name: The Tail Gate
prompt: Build a curving elevated public footbridge around a stegosaur bathing hollow. Give the sweeping tail clear space and put a keeper with brushes at a shallow ramp beside the plates.

name: The Bone Duet
prompt: Match a living hadrosaur bending to drink with an articulated skeleton in the same pose across the visitor path. Preparators winch the skeleton's last tail vertebra into place.
